_about: Goodwood's far land (tools/course/goodwood/farland.py): a mesh on the real ground beyond the ground grid (rectilinear: x lines xs, z lines zs; y metres against the post, the earth's curve taken off; colours sRGB 0-255; every cell drawn but those whose middle is inside 'hole', the ground grid), landmarks, and the panorama hung round the camera beyond it.

panorama.note: column 0 = due north, clockwise; rows from hi (top) to lo (bottom) degrees above level
